g.text: All use cases except Create account and Log in require a valid session; every user acts on their own data only (FR-02; foreign resources return 404).
Delete animation: active (queued/running) jobs must be cancelled first (decision D-03).
Out of scope (not drawn): password reset, sharing, admin panel, negative prompts, video input.
Operator tasks (model registration, account deletion) are not user capabilities.
